question: According to the Union Budget 2025-26, how many National Centres of Excellence for Skilling are to be set up with global expertise and partnerships to equip Indian youth with the skills required for “Make for India, Make for the World” manufacturing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26**, presented by Union Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman**, emphasized a significant push for the manufacturing sector and youth empowerment through advanced skilling.
 
• As part of the strategy to boost **domestic manufacturing** and global competitiveness, the government announced the establishment of **5** **National Centres of Excellence for Skilling**.
 
• These centres are designed to be developed with **global expertise and partnerships**, ensuring that the training provided is on par with international benchmarks.
 
• The primary objective of these centres is to equip the **Indian youth** with specialized skills required for the **“Make for India, Make for the World”** manufacturing vision.
 
• This initiative aims to create a highly skilled workforce that can support the expansion of **high-tech manufacturing** industries within the country, fostering both self-reliance and export capabilities.
